title: The Dragon-Slayer's Tomb
text: The tomb of a dragon-slayer, its door carved with his famous victory. Coiled around it lies the dragon he slew, its skull split by his sword, its bones furred with moss. It was never quite dead. Every so often, deep in its chest, an ember glows.

options.label: Rouse the dragon and finish what the slayer started.

outcomes.text: It wakes weak and furious. It remembers the last one who came, and means to do better this time.

options.label: The quietest slips into the tomb past it, holding their breath.

outcomes.text: Inside lies the slayer's spear, still sharp and still stained.
The dragon stirs. The ember in its chest becomes a fire.

options.label: Leave them both to their long sleep. Some victories are not finished.

outcomes.text: The dragon opens one eye, then closes it. Its breath as you pass is hot enough to cook the leather off your boots.
